text: The green color of the vomit combined with no stool passage since birth is highly concerning for intestinal obstruction. While we wait for the abdominal X-ray to look for signs of volvulus or malrotation, can you tell me if the baby has had a normal bowel movement in the first 24 hours of life, and were there any episodes of the belly becoming very distended or tender? text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus. The presentation of bilious vomiting in a newborn without prior meconium passage is classic for this life-threatening condition until proven otherwise by imaging. Immediate surgical consultation is required.
